- 한국어 changelog"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Compatibility boundaries:** DSH Runtime compatibility covers the Settings transport only: modern"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" DSH exposes `remote.settings`, while legacy DSH exposes `connection.api.settings`. The plugin detec"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ts the available runtime capability and keeps the legacy fallback optional, so the settings page doe"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"s not require a Remote provider on older DSH builds.
>
> Gateway Protocol compatibility is a separat"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"e layer. When the DSH schema exposes them, the plugin supports 18 common scalar `llm-pi-ai.compat` f"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ields, grouped into role/reasoning, format/output, streaming/tools, and storage/cache. Boolean field"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"s offer `Auto`, supported, and unsupported; enum fields offer `Auto` and their concrete values; numb"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"er fields take `Auto` or an integer. Every supported DSH release — `0.1.7-alpha.1` through `0.2.2` —"},{"id":"p5s9","text":" exposes all 18 of them when the schema supports them. The optional `dsh-llm-openai-completions` tra"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"nsport can take over eligible custom OpenAI-compatible thinking providers when it is installed and e"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"nabled. `Auto` unsets the current-layer override and restores the next value in the inheritance chai"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"n.
>
> DSH `0.1.2-alpha.1` and later accept language-pack locale IDs through `LocaleRuntime`. This p"},{"id":"p5s13","text":"lugin registers `ja` and `ko` dynamically, so no DSH core fork is required. Older DSH builds that on"},{"id":"p5s14","text":"ly expose built-in locale IDs support `zh` and `en` only.
>
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## DSH compatibility"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| DSH range | Gateway compatibility settings |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `0.1.7-alpha.1` to `<0.2.3-0` | All 18 fields when exposed by the DSH schema. This spans the `0.1."},{"id":"p8s2","text":"7` settings rewrite and the `0.2.0` through `0.2.2` lines, all verified to keep the same editable fi"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"eld set. Releases below that floor are no longer supported; releases at or beyond the newest bound a"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"re unmapped, and the plugin keeps working and follows the capabilities the running host reports inst"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"mapped, and the plugin keeps working and follows the capabilities the running host reports instead |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"From `0.1.7-alpha.1` onward, field availability follows the runtime schema. The table shows the maxi"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"mum field set for the supported range; the route protocol can further reduce it."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The `@deepseek-ai/cordis` peer accepts `^4.0.1 || ^4.0.6-alpha.1`. DSH releases through `0.2.1-rc.5`"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" build against cordis 4.0.5, `0.2.2-alpha.2` and `0.2.2-alpha.3` against 4.0.6 prereleases, and `0.2"},{"id":"p10s3","text":".2-rc.1` and later against 4.1.0; the union covers all of them so the package installs against any o"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"f these hosts. This plugin imports no cordis module directly — it reaches the runtime only through t"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"he minimal `HostContext` face it declares — so the peer is an install-time range, not a runtime capa"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"bility requirement. `engines.dsh` is now `>=0.1.7-alpha.1`: that is where the entry-config settings "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"model begins and the oldest host this plugin supports. Releases below it use the namespace model tha"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"t has been removed from the code and are no longer supported."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"A gateway compat field can be configured only when the DSH version, runtime schema, and route's `api"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"` protocol all support it. Unsupported fields stay hidden and are not written to Settings. Among the"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"se 18 fields, `openai-completions` supports all but `supportsMaxOutputTokens`, while `openai-respons"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"es`, `azure-openai-responses`, and `openai-codex-responses` support only `supportsDeveloperRole`, `s"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"upportsStrictMode`, `supportsLongCacheRetention`, and `supportsMaxOutputTokens`. If `api` is missing"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" or unrecognized, the runtime schema and DSH validation remain the final authority."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Gateway compatibility configuration"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The provider `compat` block is the global default for every model under that provider. The Settings "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"page groups the 18 fields into four sections that are collapsed by default. Configure provider defau"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"lts with the official DSH YAML shape:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Field-by-field, each value resolves independently in this order: model → provider → base/catalog → p"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"rotocol. URL/hostname detection is not used as a compat source. A model value overrides only that fi"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"eld. `Auto` removes the current-layer value, restores provider inheritance when applicable, and lets"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" the next value in the chain take effect. Provider defaults apply to every model on the route; a mod"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"el edit changes only the current model. For a route/provider, non-empty `models[]` and non-empty `mo"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"delOverrides` are mutually exclusive; the official schema rejects this invalid configuration, and th"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"e plugin fails closed for malformed data."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The provider area in Settings edits defaults for all models. Both catalog models and custom YAML `mo"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"dels[]` entries expose a single-model compat editor: catalog models write only the target fields wit"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"h field-level `set`/`unset` operations under `modelOverrides.<model>.compat`, while `models[]` model"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"s write one complete `providers.<route>.models` array set while preserving other entries and fields."},{"id":"p17s5","text":" A model edit does not change other models."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"These compat values are control plane configuration. They do not implement or replace the gateway tr"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ansport; an external transport remains responsible for network requests."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `llm-pi-ai` exposes seven standard levels: `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, and"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" `max`.
- Non-`off` levels require a gateway value. An empty `off` value means that the parameter is"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" omitted.
- The selected subagent level must be supported by the target model, or the gateway may re"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"turn `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`.
- `off` and an unset effort may both omit `reasoning`; whether "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"this disables thinking depends on the gateway protocol.
- The value a level sends is not necessarily"},{"id":"p20s6","text":" a token budget. Some gateways treat it as a prompt instruction, fold several levels onto the same b"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ehaviour (for example rewriting `high` to `xhigh`), treat `medium` as "say nothing", or fall back to"},{"id":"p20s8","text":" their own default when the parameter is absent. Check the gateway's chat template or documentation "},{"id":"p20s9","text":"before assuming that a level changes the thinking length; in such gateways an `off` value of `none` "},{"id":"p20s10","text":"is usually what actually disables thinking.
